mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 70 degree temperatures under overcast skies near Fireman Park, during a new moon phase.

The City of Verona has released official notices regarding the upcoming partisan primary and general election, and residents should also be aware that road construction begins August 18 on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks.

Today we have yoga at Insight Wellness, live music at the Concerts in the Park series, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we also have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report from last week, on August 5, officers located and arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich and indulgent Devil's Food Cake. Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
